summary.text: Allen Anderson is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 151, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Melissa Cerrato.
He has run for the Pennsylvania House in three earlier elections.

paragraphs.text: Allen Anderson was the Republican nominee for Pennsylvania House District 148 in 2020, when Democratic incumbent Mary Jo Daley defeated him with 70.1% of the vote to his 29.9%.
In 2022 he was the Republican nominee for District 54, where Democrat Greg Scott defeated him, 71.7% to 28.3%.
In 2024 he ran in District 151 and lost to Cerrato, who received 61.3% to his 38.5%.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026, setting up a rematch with Cerrato.
